warm_memory.goal: Align edit project config naming, implement endpoint whitelist filtering, and fix Jira keep-alive sync worker crash.
warm_memory.classification: coding.complex; backend sync worker batch query fix and dynamic whitelist filters
constraints: Use design-taste guidelines for visual layouts and align styles to Dark Tech aesthetics.
Unify project format to ProjectNumber-ProjectName-CarModel (Key) everywhere.
Stage and commit only intentional source modifications, leaving unrelated temp files unstaged.
decisions: Resolved formProjectName dynamically in startEdit using mapped project configurations in ProjectConfig.svelte.
Filtered GET /api/projects/config and GET /api/projects/scores by s.config.Jira.SyncProjects to exclude dirty items.
Restricted project scoring to keys that conform to Jira key format and are in SyncProjects.
Added strict format check (regex-like) for TaskIDs in jira_worker's keep-alive loop to prevent Jira 400 Bad Request error.
Restricted keep-alive query keys to configured SyncProjects only.
findings: Jira search API throws a 400 error for the whole batch if even one key is malformed (e.g. user name or process name), causing all valid keys to fail syncing.
validation: go build check: backend build passed.
warm_memory.next: Deliver final status to the user and prompt verification.
